{{Combat}} [[Cauldron|The Cauldron]] |affiliation = [[Dark Iron clan]], [[Thorium Brotherhood]] }} The '''Searing Gorge''' is a contested region in southern [[Khaz Modan]]. It is home to a group of exceptionally stout [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron dwarves]] called the [[Thorium Brotherhood]], who have split from the [[Dark Iron clan]]. ==Geography== There are no instances actually located in the Searing Gorge. However, [[Blackrock Mountain]] lies between it and the [[Burning Steppes]]. It is home to [[Blackrock Depths]], [[Blackrock Spire]], [[Molten Core]], and [[Blackwing Lair]]. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-SearingGorge.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Searing Gorge.]] WorldMap-SearingGorge-old.jpg|Searing Gorge prior to [[patch 1.5.0]]. {{clrl}} {| class="fandom-table" |- || [[Blackchar Cave]] • [[Blackrock Mountain]] • [[Cauldron|The Cauldron]] ([[Slag Pit|The Slag Pit]]) • [[Dustfire Valley]] • [[Grimesilt Dig Site]] • [[Firewatch Ridge]] • [[Sea of Cinders|The Sea of Cinders]] • [[Stonewrought Pass]] • [[Tanner Camp]] • [[Thorium Point]] |- |} {{clrl}} === Travel hubs === ===== {{Neutral}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Thorium Point]] ===== * {{Alliance}} [[Ironforge]], [[Dun Morogh]] * {{Alliance}} [[Ambershire]], [[Northwind]] * {{Alliance}} [[Morgan's Vigil]], [[Burning Steppes]] * {{Horde}} [[Kargath]], [[Badlands|The Badlands]] * {{Horde}} [[Flame Crest]], [[Burning Steppes]] ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="fandom-table" |- !
